summary: Three of the six preserved ralph-plugin-beta-graph runs have no events.jsonl, logs/, or operator/ directory at the run root. Only graph.json, observability.jsonl, orchestration-plans/, and run.json exist. There is no per-run supervisor.log or admission.jsonl to reconstruct scheduling decisions for these runs.
operatorImpact: An operator opening one of the three affected run directories has no supervisor.log, no events feed, and no operator/requests directory to explain why the run is stuck or what to do next. The run.json schemaVersion for these three is 1; the two later runs are schemaVersion 2 and carry the missing root artifacts, showing the gap was closed only in the newer runtime version, not backfilled onto older runs.
